title: Chicken Roll-Ups
description: Sliced chicken breast rolled with deli meat and mozzarella, seared and baked — a high-protein finger food great for meal prep.

ingredients.text: 2g garlic powder, 2g smoked paprika, salt, pepper

steps: Butterfly and flatten chicken breasts. Season with garlic powder, paprika, salt and pepper.
Layer deli meat and mozzarella on each breast; roll tightly and secure with toothpicks.
Sear rolls in oil on medium-high heat 2 min each side until golden.
Bake at 180°C/350°F 15 min until cooked through. Remove toothpicks; slice and portion.
macrosNote: Whole recipe (4 servings). Per serving: 300 kcal, 44g protein
notes: Lasts 3–4 days in fridge. Great with cauliflower mash or salad.
